summary_notes: Global legal knowledge search. Primary need: accurate cross-lingual retrieval + low-cost reranking for top-k results. Corpus ~12M docs (policies, contracts, advisories) in 12 languages but first phase EN/DE/FR. Customer cares about per-language recall and precision; wants per-language tuning and metrics. Emphasis on deterministic SLA for latency during business hours (EMEA). Prefer dedicated GPUs for steady QPS; private deployment considered if residency closed. Quote from Head of Search: 'We need top-5 recall >85% for each language, otherwise UX is confusing.'
technical_requirements: Indexing scale: initial 12M documents, expected to grow 2x in 12 months; vector storage + metadata; incremental reindexing cadence: nightly
QPS / Latency targets: 200-500 qps for embedding lookup; end-to-end (embedding + candidate retrieval + rerank) SLA <350ms P95 for EN/DE/FR; higher tail for long docs acceptable
Reranking: top-100 dense candidates -> lightweight cross-encoder rerank top-10; budget allows approx 10k rerank ops/day in POC; long-term plan 200k/day
Per-query cost sensitivity: target blended cost <= $0.006/query (embeddings + rerank); immediate goal <$0.01/query for demo), exploring quantized models for cost reduction
Multilingual model strategy: evaluate dedicated per-language encoders vs. single multilingual model. Need baseline per-language recall/precision plots and support for per-language reweighting
Search relevance metrics: top-5 recall >=85% per language; precision@5 >=70%; plan to produce evaluation set (1000 queries per language) during POC
Tooling: want token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, per-language telemetry in Console; automatic fallback to cheaper model for non-critical queries
Security & compliance: SSO (SAML), enterprise audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for keys, data residency DE/EU; SOC2/ISO controls required for procurement
poC_scope: ingest 3-language snapshot (~120k docs), run hybrid ANN+rerank baseline, compare: multilingual-similarity (single model) vs per-language tuned encoders; deliver per-language PR curves and cost-per-query estimates
